source_state: uncommitted same-operation output alias contract and joint-router native workspace facts
behavior: WorkspaceOutputStorage::AliasOutput references an earlier result of the same operation. Validation rejects forward, self and cyclic references before trace mutation. Aliases share the complete root, including possible input aliases, without another allocation charge.

Neutral tests retain shared backing across different shapes, chained views, dropped siblings, empty logical views and span transitions. Existing/possible input roots remain reachable exactly once, and unknown retained capacity keeps the complete inference transient bound unknown.

Joint routing prices hidden flattening, dense projection, sigmoid/correction ranking, native Metal partition buffers, direct unbiased-logit gathering, concatenation, log-sigmoid, precise softmax and fixed/learned scaling. Native scalar buffers are included; there is no disjoint host numerical payload.

Selected IDs retain the complete partition-index backing. Selected and always-on coefficients retain one shared full coefficient allocation through the output-alias contract, including when only the always-on view remains live.

240 native configurations cover five geometries, two coefficient scales, F32/F16/BF16 activations, full/lower precision parameters, contiguous/strided inputs and tied/non-tied rankings. Coverage includes all-group selection, multiple leading ranks, empty batches and 4097 selectable groups.

Independent F64 host equations validate unbiased coefficients, unique in-range selected IDs and top-k cutoff validity without imposing a tie order. Every measured active native allocation peak fits its cold bound; native identities and capacities prove shared coefficient backing and retained full index storage.

Neutral joint-selection admission rejects overflowing group-count sums and zero hidden widths before execution. Existing initial/cached prepared native routes continue to pass; remaining ordinary top-k/grouped operator gaps remain explicit.

tolerances.ranking: selected cutoff compared with the same floating tolerance; ties permit any unique valid IDs
tolerances.reference: actual native inputs converted to F32 after measurement, then independent F64 dot/sigmoid/normalization arithmetic

limits: This completes a joint-selector operation fact, not a complete routed-family request budget. Ordinary top-k selection, grouped expert execution, addressable expert schedules, materialization/transfers, paging, TP/PP, media, observation, prediction lanes and independent copies still need complete prices or composition.

The native bound covers joint dense routing in the at-most-F32 metadata envelope. Other domains remain explicitly unknown; output aliasing cannot confer a missing workspace bound or copy/submission authority.

Bounds cover active managed payload storage through completion, not allocator cache, native shape/command metadata, driver/JIT, total process or system memory. No new process-memory or released-checkpoint experiment was run.

Two cold routing tests occur in both backend suites, giving 133 unique tests. The workspace suite leaves 35 controlled native/allocator benchmarks ignored; the new joint benchmark was explicitly run in the focused suite.
Existing large-unwind linker and unused internal quote/helper warnings remain in logs.
